billing.hint: So the bot keeps replying after the 1,000 free monthly messages run out, your Meta account needs a card on file.

mode.title: Do you want to keep using WhatsApp on your phone?
mode.coexistenceHint: Connect the same number without losing your WhatsApp. Togo handles orders and you reply from your phone whenever you want.
mode.cloudTitle: No, use a new number just for Togo
mode.cloudHint: The number lives only in the cloud, with no app on the phone.
mode.coexistenceNote: You need the WhatsApp Business app updated (v2.24.17+). Connecting unlinks WhatsApp Web and desktop: they must be relinked. Via API there are no groups, calls or live location (in the app, yes).

routing.autoAssignDescription: One number for all branches. The bot asks which branch the customer wants to order from.

business.sectionDescription: One number for all branches. Customers will choose their branch when placing an order.

usage.paymentRequired: Quota used up: check your payment

usage.botMessagesPerOrder: Bot average: {count} messages per order this month
usage.loadError: Could not load usage. Check your connection and try again.

attention.title: Attention mode

BOT_ONLY.label: Bot only
BOT_ONLY.hint: The bot answers everything, except handoff.

HYBRID.label: Hybrid
HYBRID.hint: The bot answers unless out of hours or operator busy.

ATTENTION_MANUAL.label: Human only
ATTENTION_MANUAL.hint: The bot never replies: it leaves drafts for the team.

attention.minutesLabel: Release the conversation if the human does not reply (minutes)
attention.scheduleHint: Unchecked day = closed (the bot pauses). Business time.
attention.rangeError: Check the hours: closing must be after opening. If a shift goes past midnight, split it across two days.
attention.scheduleEmptyError: In hybrid mode, check at least one day: with no days, the bot never pauses for hours.

branchAttention.title: Per-branch attention
branchAttention.dedicatedHint: This branch has its own number: mode, schedule and operator busy are evaluated only here.
branchAttention.sharedHint: This branch shares a number: schedule and operator busy are evaluated at business level.
branchAttention.inheritScheduleDedicated: Without its own schedule, the branch commercial hours apply.
branchAttention.inheritScheduleShared: Without its own schedule, the business schedule applies.
branchAttention.dedicatedOnlyHint: Each branch has its own number: attention is configured on each branch page.
